concurrency_and_state: Single-threaded Unity UI class (`Panel`) instantiated as dual globals (`GameCanvas.panel` and lazily via `EnsurePanel2()` as `GameCanvas.panel2`), yet several methods inside `Panel` directly reference `GameCanvas.panel` (`updateKey` line 2197, `paint` line 4294, `paintPetInventory` line 4871) or mutate `static` tab arrays (`boxTabName`, `boxCombine`, `boxPet`) at runtime.

Trade session state (`moneyGD`, `friendMoneyGD`, `isLock`, `isFriendLock`, `isAccept`, `isFriendAccep`, `vMyGD`, `vFriendGD`) is stored as mutable public fields on `Panel`; `setTypeGiaoDich` (lines 2453-2459) resets all trade flags except `isFriendAccep`.

Shared `static` collections (`a..h`, `a_bg..h_bg`, `vGameInfo`) and `static` state (`specialInfo`, `spearcialImage`, `lastItemInvenNew`, `cachedOptionText`, `cachedOptionFont`, `lastLogPanelPaintErrorTime`) are accessed across panel instances without synchronization.
cross_module_questions: How do `InventorySubPanel`, `ChestSubPanel`, `CombineSubPanel`, `ShopSubPanel`, and `ClanSubPanel` (registered in `InitSubPanels` lines 939-946) interact with `Panel`'s legacy fields (`selected`, `cmy`, `currentTabIndex`), and which `Panel` methods in lines 5644-11857 are still called when `ISubPanel.Paint`/`UpdateKey` returns false?
Does `Service.gI().kigui` validate page bounds server-side when `updateKeyScrollView` (lines 3068-3123) or `moveCamera` (lines 4043-4060) sends negative or out-of-range page indices?
Where is `Panel.tabName[0/1/5/6]` populated before `setType()` (line 1179) runs, and are `tabName` entries guaranteed non-null on all entry points?
Does server trade handling enforce `long` vs `int` for trade gold (`moneyGD`, `friendMoneyGD` are 32-bit `int` at lines 85-87)?

findings.impact: NullReferenceException when rendering consignment or shop rows containing a null Item slot, breaking `paintShop` and causing repeated console errors.
findings.root_cause: `paintShop` guards `if (item != null)` at line 4580, but after closing that block at line 4750, line 4751 unconditionally evaluates `item.buyType == 0` without checking `item == null`.
findings.title: NullReferenceException in paintShop when item slot is null

findings.impact: Opening clan search or tapping while `clans` is null throws NullReferenceException; switching to `setTabClans` with fewer than 4 tabs throws IndexOutOfRangeException.
findings.root_cause: `getCurrClan()` reads `clans.Length` without checking `clans != null`; `setTabClans()` reads `lastSelect[3]` without bounds check; `setTabKiGui()` and `setTabShop()` read `Char.myCharz().arrItemShop[...].Length` without null/length checks.
findings.title: Missing null and bounds checks in getCurrClan, setTabClans, setTabKiGui, and setTabShop

findings.impact: Option 107 visual aura/frame effect renders the wrong tier or null whenever an item has any subsequent option with param != option 107's param.
findings.root_cause: `paintEff` checks `item.isHaveOption(107)` then loops over every `option` in `item.itemOption`, overwriting `img_frame` and `img_bg` based on `option.param` regardless of `option.optionTemplate.id`.
findings.title: paintEff overwrites option 107 effect lists with unrelated item option params

findings.impact: Swipe inertia velocity calculation (`num5` at line 3287) uses stale `pointerDownLastX[1]` and `pointerDownLastX[2]` values from previous drags; `sellectInventory` can go negative in `updateKeyInTabBar`.
findings.root_cause: In `updateKeyScrollView`, the initialization loop writes `pointerDownLastX[0] = GameCanvas.py;` on every iteration instead of `pointerDownLastX[i]`; in `updateKeyInTabBar`, `if (sellectInventory < 0) {}` has an empty body.
findings.title: Scroll pointer history loop bug and empty negative clamp in updateKeyInTabBar

findings.impact: Stutter/freeze on the Unity main thread whenever the player opens or refreshes the World Map panel, plus 2x duplicate image references loaded by `loadEff()`.
findings.root_cause: `setTabMap()` synchronously invokes `Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets(); GC.Collect();`; `loadEff()` loops `for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)` without using `i`, appending all 8 `bgList`/`imgList` entries twice (16 entries per list).
findings.title: Blocking GC.Collect/UnloadUnusedAssets on map tab open and duplicate effect image loading

findings.impact: High per-frame GC pressure and frame drops in Unity UI render loops when panels are open.
findings.root_cause: `paintGiaoDich`, `paintShop`, `paintPetInventory`, `paintSkill`, `paintSpeacialSkill`, `paintBox`, and `paintLogChat` allocate strings every frame via concatenation (`+`, `Res.formatNumber`), call `splitFontArray` (`5150`, `5340`) and `Res.split` (`5586`, `5590`) inside `paint()`, and most iterate all items instead of only visible `cmy` rows.
findings.title: Per-frame heap allocations, string splits, and unculled loops inside Panel paint methods

findings.impact: Stale `isFriendAccep` flag from a prior trade can persist into a new trade; 32-bit `int` limits trade gold representation to ~2.14B.
findings.root_cause: `setTypeGiaoDich` resets `isAccept`, `isLock`, `isFriendLock`, `moneyGD`, `friendMoneyGD`, `vMyGD`, `vFriendGD`, but omits resetting `isFriendAccep = false`. `moneyGD` and `friendMoneyGD` are `int` rather than `long`.
findings.title: Trade state reset omits isFriendAccep and uses 32-bit int for trade gold

findings.impact: High maintenance risk and regression surface across ~30 panel modes and dual-panel layouts (`panel` / `panel2`).
findings.root_cause: God class `Panel` (11,857 lines total) mixes partial `ISubPanel` delegation (`InventorySubPanel`, `ChestSubPanel`, `CombineSubPanel`, `ShopSubPanel`, `ClanSubPanel`) with legacy monolithic switch/paint/updateKey logic, duplicated item-row rendering in 4+ methods, dead stub methods (`setTabChatPlayer`, `IsNewMessage`, `updateKeyAuto`, `subArray`, `paintPetSkill`), copy-paste ternary (`GetColor_ItemBg` twice at lines 4865/5401), and wrong log context (`"paintPetInventory"` in `paintBox` catch at line 5494).
findings.title: Monolithic Panel God Class with partial ISubPanel migration and copy-paste defects

key_classes.name: Panel
key_classes.responsibility: Central UI panel God class (`IActionListener, IChatable`) handling inventory, chest, shop, consignment, trade, combine, clans, skills, pet, map, zones, top rankings, chat logs, and sub-panel delegation.

key_classes.name: Panel.PlayerChat
key_classes.responsibility: Nested data class holding per-player chat history (`name`, `charID`, `isNewMessage`, `List<InfoItem> chats`).

module_summary: Read lines 1-5643 of `Client/Client/Assets/Scripts/Game1/Panel.cs` (part 1 of 2 of the 11,857-line UI God class). This half defines `Panel` fields/constants, `ISubPanel` registration (`InventorySubPanel`, `ChestSubPanel`, `CombineSubPanel`, `ShopSubPanel`, `ClanSubPanel`), asset loading (`loadEff`, `loadBg`), detail popups (`addItemDetail`, `addClanDetail`, `addSkillDetail`, etc.), input/scroll handling (`updateKey`, `updateKeyScrollView`, `updateKeyInTabBar`, `updateKeyMap`, `updateKeyQuest`, `updateKeyClans`), tab initialization (`setType*`, `setTab*`), camera/close transitions (`moveCamera`), and core rendering (`paint`, `paintDetail`, `paintTop`, `paintGiaoDich`, `paintShop`, `paintPetInventory`, `paintSkill`, `paintZone`, `paintSpeacialSkill`, `paintBox`, `paintLogChat`, `paintFlagChange`).
